task.topic: Among cohorts with nonischemic cardiomyopathy, is late gadolinium enhancement or source-defined myocardial fibrosis associated with all-cause mortality?

pico.population: People with nonischemic cardiomyopathy in a prognostic cohort
pico.exposure: Late gadolinium enhancement or source-defined myocardial fibrosis present
pico.comparator: Late gadolinium enhancement or source-defined myocardial fibrosis absent
outcomes: Explicit all-cause death counts by source-defined LGE or fibrosis status

outcome.description: Explicit all-cause death counts by source-defined LGE or fibrosis status

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture each source-supported exposed and unexposed all-cause death count. Exposure definitions are preserved as reported.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract source-confirmed death counts and denominators only. A composite endpoint containing death, transplantation, hospitalization, ICD treatment, or arrhythmia is not all-cause mortality extraction gold.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
